How to describe environmental realization

Write the actual environment account at references/situated/environment.md in the private package. Explain how this collaboration takes working form through material, social, informational, and computational arrangements. Connect the adopted orientation, person, counterpart, and relationship to actual possibilities and consequences. A configuration inventory says what exists; this account explains what it enables, for whom, under which conditions.

Give the relation a reachable working form

Start with activities the participants undertake and the points where a contribution depends on a resource, channel, or action route. A person may express an unfinished idea in speech; the counterpart receives a transcript, recovers a work, inspects sources, and writes or implements a result. Explain the passage among these contributions. The environment includes the person's attention, places, other people, and social evaluation where they affect the activity, as well as the computer through which contributions are realized.

Ground the description in current evidence. Identify maintained owners and usable locators. A human-visible file is not automatically model-readable; a named service is not automatically callable. An advisory contribution needs a route to its execution owner; an executable action needs observable readback. Capability, authentication, and authority remain with their real owners.

Describe the routes ordinary work actually depends on. In learning, where is the selected text maintained, how does an explanation reach the person, and how do both return to the disputed passage? In implementation, how is the project recovered, how does the chosen behavior acquire an executable form, and where can the result be inspected? Include known gaps and conditions. Specialist Skills own their methods; link useful entrances instead of copying their complete procedures here.

Locate the passage that needs support

Understanding, retrieval, beginning, responding, stopping, and switching are different achievements. An explanation can clarify a relation while leaving the next action inaccessible. The formation method's continuation example distinguishes competing explanations for a saved note that does not help resume an argument. Describe which note and draft matter, their connection, each participant's contribution, and where continuation fails. Keep a proposed route recognizable as a proposal until its availability and effects are established.

Assess the cost of the arrangement as used. A tool may save operations while adding setup, monitoring, handoff repair, or repeated context reconstruction. A record preserves material; retrieval makes it available; action changes the work. Relief concerns experience, while learning concerns what the person can subsequently understand or do. The participation and support essay develops these differences. A smaller arrangement can support the activity better than a larger inventory.

Let realization correct the account

Harness adaptation carries operational changes through their actual owners and checks the intended effect. Update this account from the observed result, keeping planned and realized arrangements distinct. An unavailable source may call for a route repair; persistent poor fit may challenge the person account, division of work, or orientation.

Keep private locators with their private owners and trace useful claims through the evidence material. An accessible file establishes retrieval; a real activity continuing through it establishes more. The account condenses selected relations within an environment that remains richer and changeable.
